name: Shellback Snail
notes: DRAFT for C13-1 (bestiary-plan.md). A slow snail that hides in its shell when hit too often. Stats are TODO for the Researcher (ENEMY_SCALE). Distances in tiles, times in ticks (20 per second).
senseiLine: Patience. It always peeks out again.
description: A slow snail that hides in its shell when hit too often.

bestiary.tip: Wait for it to peek out, or STRIKE the shell.

lore.yellow: It hid in its shell when the shadow came, and it forgot how to come out. Be patient, and it peeks out calm again.
